title: Corrigir unidade e moeda na fronteira BI

original_finding.trigger: A producer-authorized BI projection value with unit='hours', currency='USD' is referenced by a presentation series with unit='USD'. The guard returns status ok, because it checks unit mismatch AND currency mismatch, allowing currency equality to mask explicit physical unit contradiction. The renderer uses series.unit and groups amounts under USD.
original_finding.root_cause: Boolean conjunction at semantics.ts:21 accepts either currency or unit as a substitute for an explicitly conflicting other dimension.
original_finding.criticality: Incorrect financial label/scale or heterogeneous chart; source producer authorization is independent and not bypassed by this finding.

proof.observed: Guard does not reject incompatible explicit unit when currency equals entry.unit.
proof.not_proven: No installed BI fixture or runtime artifact run by 208.

owner.writer: A08/BI producer-semantic authority; N26 U20/U21 consumers under active lease only

original_finding.requested_fix: On source-origin BI semantic boundary, reject contradictory explicit unit/currency; do not infer conversion or mix FTE and cost and do not weaken absent/zero rules.

recheck.minimal_proof: Positive USD currency series and FTE unit series independently, negative conflicting explicit hours+USD versus USD series, mixed currency rejection, zero/null table parity, no invented FX and correct scale labels.
